sv.summary: Vi uppmanar politiken att snarast införa de styrmedel som ger elektrifieringen ekonomiska förutsättningar att ta fart. en.title: New fraud traps ahead of Black Friday

sv.title: Experter: Nu ökar trycket på Östersjön

en.title: Climate researcher after the COP collapse: A tough situation

sv.title: Det var här och nu som Kina gick om USA
sv.summary: SHENZHEN. November 2026. När historikerna skriver om den här månaden kommer de att markera något betydelsefullt: det var då Kina symboliskt gick om USA som världens ledande tekniknation. De gjorde det inte bara tack vare egen förmåga, utan ett häpnadsväckande självdestruktivt agerande i väst.

en.title: This is where and when China overtook the US
en.summary: SHENZHEN. November 2026. When historians write about this month, they will mark something significant: that was when China symbolically overtook the US as the world's leading technology nation. They did so not only thanks to their own capability, but also through an astonishingly self-destructive course of action in the West.

en.summary: The COP31 climate summit is in overtime. More than 40 hours after the meeting was due to end, there is no agreement, and more and more delegates are leaving the meeting.

sv.title: Efter åtta år – europeisk rymdfarkost nära Merkurius
sv.summary: Efter åtta år har rymdfarkosten Bepicolombo, som ska studera solens närmaste granne Merkurius, gått in i planetens omloppsbana, skriver det europeiska rymdorganet ESA på X.

en.title: After eight years – European spacecraft near Mercury
en.summary: After eight years, the spacecraft BepiColombo, which is to study the Sun's nearest neighbour Mercury, has entered orbit around the planet, the European space agency ESA writes on X.

sv.title: Bred kritik på toppmötet: ”Kommer inte acceptera”

en.title: Broad criticism at the summit: "Will not accept it"

en.title: Swedish Roam secures funding for 226,000 electric motorcycles
en.summary: The Swedish startup Roam, which manufactures electric motorcycles in Kenya, has signed a groundbreaking climate agreement with Switzerland that secures funding for as many as 226,000 electric motorcycles.

en.summary: Items belonging to passengers on the Titanic have been sold at auction for record sums, reports the BBC.

en.title: Fossil fuels missing from climate draft
en.summary: Wording on fossil fuels has been a sticking point at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey. In overnight's draft of the summit's final document, the words remain struck out. "Everything has been watered down a little," says Martin Wadmark, climate expert at WWF, in a written comment.

sv.title: Novos fetmapiller snart i Sverige – ”mycket pengar”

en.title: Novo's weight-loss pills soon in Sweden – “a lot of money”

en.summary: As AI services get better, the number of data breaches will increase, says cybersecurity expert Marcus Murray. "The effect of developments in AI has led to vulnerabilities being exposed as never before. That is why companies can't keep up," he tells TT.

sv.title: Swedish Fintech rasar mot ny EU-skatt på nätjättar

During the sale week starting on Monday, Swedes will spend SEK 12 billion more than during an ordinary week. Planned Christmas purchases at lower prices are attracting shoppers, but private economists warn against unnecessary impulse buying.

sv.title: Klassiskt redarkvarter blir pråliga kåkar på konstö

sv.title: C-topp: V inte beredda att kompromissa

sv.title: Skatt på nätjättar i bantad budget i EU

sv.title: Svenskens nya uppdrag: Ena USA och Europa mot Ryssland
